per_question.answer: To avoid academic warning, an undergraduate needs to maintain a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.00. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]

If a student's CGPA stays below 2.00 for three consecutive semesters, their admission to the University is automatically closed. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]
A student can repeat a maximum of 2 courses in a summer semester, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 6. Rules for Summer Semester].

Students earning an SGPA of 4.00 with at least 30 credit hours are placed on the Rector's List of Honors. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 7. Awards and the Honor System > Rector’s List of Honors]

If a teacher refers a cheating case to the Department Disciplinary Committee, the maximum punishment of 'F' grade can be awarded in that course. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 8. Academic Honesty > Penalties for Academic Dishonesty]

A student is not allowed to submit an assignment written by a generative AI tool as their own work. This is stated in passage C, which lists example 5: Submitting assessed work where the use of Generative AI has been cited, but the prompt given is in contravention of good academic practice. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Unacceptable Uses of Generative AI Tools]

The tuition fee is refunded in accordance with the guidelines of Higher Education Commission (HEC). According to the fee refund policy, if a student leaves within the first 15 days of classes, 80% of the tuition fee is refunded. [fee-structure-page.html / Fee Refund Policy]

A faculty member must have been a full-time faculty member for more than 1 year to be eligible to start a technical start-up. [faculty-entrepreneurship-and-technical-start-ups-policy.pdf / 1. Purpose > Eligibility criteria for a technical start-up]
According to the 2023-24 annual report, the Islamabad campus had a total of 236 faculty members. [annual-report-2023-24.pdf / CFD ISB KHI LHR PWR > Faculty Summary]

The deadline to withdraw from a course is the last day of the makeup week of every semester, as stated in section 4.25 of the Academic Rules Handbook, June 2026 edition, page 22. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]
A regular semester is spread over 16 weeks of teaching, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Academic Year].
Under the older 2023 academic rules, the deadline to withdraw from a course was the last day of classes. [undergraduate-academic-rules-aug-2023.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]

Students are required to maintain 100% attendance in lectures, labs, tutorials, seminars, and discussions as prescribed by the course instructor. Absence of a maximum of 20% of the total attendance may be condoned by the HoD for genuine reasons, such as illness, etc. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Attendance Requirements]
The paper rechecking fee per course is Rs. 500, as stated in section 'Miscellaneous Fees' of the fee-structure-page.html, [fee-structure-page.html / Miscellaneous Fees].
A B- grade is worth 2.67 grade points. [prospectus-2026-academic-rules-and-regulations.pdf / 6. Letter Grades and Grade Points]
